trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State time pressure, provide phone number and request plan downgrade.
steps.text: ನನಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ time ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ number MSN-1002. Bill ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಬರ್ತಿದೆ, ನನ್ plan downgrade ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು.

steps.model_visible_text: ನನಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ time ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ number MSN-1002. Bill ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಬರ್ತಿದೆ, ನನ್ plan downgrade ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು.

steps.purpose: Check the current plan and billing cycle status before making any recommendations.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_subscriber using the MSISDN provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: Must read the current state (BR_TEL_04) before discussing plan changes.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge current plan and ask for a verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: State the current plan and ask for a security factor to verify identity.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ, ನೀವು ಈಗ PP799 postpaid plan ನಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀರಾ. Security ಗಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ registered pincode ಹೇಳ್ತೀರಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity must be verified before making account changes. Acknowledging the current plan grounds the response in the tool output.

steps.purpose: Provide verification factor and reiterate time pressure.
steps.text: Pincode 560001. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ check ಮಾಡಿ, ನಾನ್ meeting ಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕು.
steps.clean_text: Pincode 560001. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ check ಮಾಡಿ, ನಾನ್ meeting ಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕು.
steps.model_visible_text: Pincode 560001. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ check ಮಾಡಿ, ನಾನ್ meeting ಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕು.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the MSISDN established in s1 and the pincode from s5.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to verify identity before querying the catalogue or applying changes. Reusing the MSISDN exercises slot value recall.

steps.purpose: List available plans to find a cheaper option.
steps.expected_behavior: Call list_plans to retrieve available plans for the user.
steps.planner_rationale: Must fetch plans from the catalogue to offer a valid downgrade option (BR_TEL_01).

steps.purpose: Confirm verification and offer the cheapest plan.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user about the PP299 plan and its price.
steps.text: Verification successful ಆಗಿದೆ. ನಮ್ ಹತ್ರ PP299 plan ಇದೆ, ಅದಕ್ಕೆ 299 rupees ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಅದನ್ನ activate ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Offering the lowest tier plan since the customer explicitly asked to reduce their bill.

steps.purpose: Ask for data limits and specify a minimum requirement.
steps.text: ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು data ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ? ನಂಗೆ at least 20GB ಬೇಕು.
steps.clean_text: ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು data ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ? ನಂಗೆ at least 20GB ಬೇಕು.
steps.model_visible_text: ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು data ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ? ನಂಗೆ at least 20GB ಬೇಕು.

steps.purpose: Check for plans that meet the new 20GB minimum data requirement.
steps.expected_behavior: Call list_plans again with min_data_gb set to 20.
steps.planner_rationale: Customer added a constraint, so the catalogue must be queried again to find matching plans.

steps.purpose: Return plans with at least 20GB data.
Offer the plan that meets the 20GB requirement.
steps.expected_behavior: Offer the PP399 plan, stating the data and price accurately.
steps.text: 20GB data ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ PP399 plan ಇದೆ. ಇದರ price 399 rupees. ಇದನ್ನ apply ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Presenting the exact match for the customer's 20GB requirement based purely on the tool output.

steps.purpose: Accept the plan and request immediate activation.
steps.text: ಹಾ, ಅದೇ PP399 plan ನ immediately change ಮಾಡಿ.
steps.clean_text: ಹಾ, ಅದೇ PP399 plan ನ immediately change ಮಾಡಿ.
steps.model_visible_text: ಹಾ, ಅದೇ PP399 plan ನ immediately change ಮಾಡಿ.

steps.expected_behavior: Call apply_recharge to migrate the plan.
steps.planner_rationale: Customer confirmed the plan. Reusing the MSISDN from the first turn.

steps.purpose: Confirm the transaction and enforce the postpaid cycle business rule.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the transaction ID and explicitly state that the change takes effect next cycle, using the days_to_cycle_end figure.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ request ತಗೊಂಡಿದೀನಿ. Transaction id TXN-9921. Postpaid rule ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಈ change next billing cycle ಇಂದ, ಅಂದ್ರೆ 12 days ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ apply ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: Must enforce BR_TEL_02 (no immediate postpaid changes) and ground the response in the days_to_cycle_end (12 days) from the initial lookup.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the effective date and end the call.
steps.text: Okay, 12 days ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ change ಆದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು. Thanks.
steps.clean_text: Okay, 12 days ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ change ಆದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು. Thanks.
steps.model_visible_text: Okay, 12 days ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ change ಆದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು. Thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated, and subscriber told why the change cannot take effect now.
